task_completion.description: Load both 1HRC and 1YCC PDB files into the PyMOL workspace.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list (right panel) shows both '1HRC' and '1YCC' as loaded objects.

task_completion.description: Perform a structural alignment/superposition of the two cytochrome c structures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows two protein backbones overlapping closely; the PyMOL command output area displays an RMSD value.

task_completion.description: Color the two structures differently to distinguish between the horse and yeast versions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows the two superimposed proteins in two distinct, different colors (e.g., green and cyan).

task_completion.description: Identify and highlight the heme group and its axial ligands (His18 and Met80).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D viewer shows the heme group (usually sticks/organic) and specific side chains (His18, Met80) highlighted or labeled.

task_completion.description: Render and save a high-resolution PNG image to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command log shows a 'png' command targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/cytc_conservation.png' or a file explorer window confirms the file's existence.

task_completion.description: Write a text report containing the RMSD, PDB IDs, conserved residues, and a 5-line analysis.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command displays the content of '~/PyMOL_Data/cytc_conservation_report.txt' containing the required elements.

integrity.description: The agent used PyMOL commands or GUI menus rather than just creating a text file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with commands like 'align', 'super', or 'color' visible in the history.

integrity.description: The RMSD value in the report should match the value generated by the software during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The RMSD value shown in the PyMOL external GUI/terminal matches the value written in the final .txt report.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested directories, not default locations.
integrity.visual_evidence: Command history or file explorer shows paths including '~/PyMOL_Data/images/' and '~/PyMOL_Data/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected RMSD for 1HRC and 1YCC is typically around 0.3 to 1.0 Angstroms depending on the alignment method used. The axial ligands are His18 and Met80 in both structures. The image file must be at least 30,000 bytes to be considered high-resolution. The report must be at least 5 lines long and explicitly mention PDB IDs 1HRC and 1YCC.
